import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    c=np.cos(w*t); s=np.sin(w*t)
    e=np.exp(-v)
    return (params[1]+params[2]*s+params[3]*c+params[4]*np.log(v)*t+params[5]*e*t*s
            +params[6]*e+params[7]*v*t*c+params[8]*v*v*t*c+params[9]*e*s)
